_meta.purpose: Per-model $/MTok rates so harness-metrics derives dollar cost from token usage (there is no dollar-cost field in the session JSONL).
_meta.schema: each model id maps to {input_per_mtok, output_per_mtok, cache_read_per_mtok, cache_write_per_mtok} in USD per 1,000,000 tokens
_meta.STATUS: input/output rates VERIFIED 2026-06-24 against the first-party Anthropic price table (via the claude-api skill's Current Models table). cache_read/cache_write are DERIVED from Anthropic's standard ratio (cache_read = 0.1x input, cache_write(5m) = 1.25x input) EXCEPT the Fable cache_read, which the skill states directly as $0.25/MTok; confirm the exact cache rates per model if cache-heavy cost precision matters.
_meta.verified_source: claude-api skill — Current Models table (Anthropic first-party API rates), cached 2026-06-24
_meta.caveats: First-party rates only (Bedrock/Vertex differ). Opus 5/4.8 fast mode is billed at $10/$50 but shares the same model id, so fast-mode sessions are under-costed here. Batch API is ~50% of these rates.
_meta.note_keys: keys beginning with _ are metadata and are ignored by the parser (it only looks up real model ids seen in transcripts).
